art_direction: 弯茎莲蓬朝向画面中央，一片卷边荷叶铺开，少量灰绿晕染。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Paint a bent lotus stem carrying one mature seedpod that turns inward toward the viewer. Balance its compact dotted head with a single folded lotus leaf opening below like a fan. The leaf should be an expressive gray-green wash with two dry ink veins, not a botanical diagram. Keep the stem as a slender uneven gesture and leave the pod rim defined. Use soft ivory paper and a small empty crescent between leaf and pod to make the silhouette readable. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
